1. Description

This pairing examines total annual precipitation over land in the contiguous United States (CONUS). It builds upon Figures 1 and 3 in EPA’s U.S. and Global Precipitation indicator and includes the following components:

  • Historical observations since 1901.
  • Modeled projections from 2015 to 2100 for four climate scenarios.
  • A modeled hindcast from 1950 to 2014.
